title: My Weekend Blog
text:
Hi everyone! This weekend I visited my friend Ana in Lisbon. We walked by the river and ate fish at a small restaurant. The food was very good, and the weather was warm.

On Sunday we went to a market and bought some fruit and bread. I took many photos, and I posted them on this blog. Next weekend I want to visit the mountains with my family.

paragraph_translations: Oi, pessoal! Este fim de semana visitei minha amiga Ana em Lisboa. Caminhamos pelo rio e comemos peixe em um pequeno restaurante. A comida estava muito boa, e o tempo estava quente.
No domingo fomos a um mercado e compramos frutas e pão. Tirei muitas fotos e as publiquei neste blog. No próximo fim de semana quero visitar as montanhas com a minha família.
